description: This file defines the Secant class which provides methods to compute the secant and hyperbolic secant functions for given angles, supporting both scalar and array inputs within a spreadsheet calculation context.

classes.name: Secant
classes.description: Provides methods to compute the secant and hyperbolic secant mathematical functions for single values or arrays of values, used within spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: sec
methods.description: Calculates the secant of an angle, supporting array and scalar inputs.

methods.name: sech
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic secant of an angle, supporting array and scalar inputs.
